description: Source code for a mail splitting utility that processes mbox and Maildir formats, splitting email messages into individual files.

methods.name: is_from_line
methods.description: Checks if a line matches the 'From ' email separator pattern with a date.

methods.name: is_gtfrom
methods.description: Checks if a buffer starts with '>From ' pattern.

methods.name: split_one
methods.description: Splits a single email message from the mailbox stream into a separate file.

methods.name: populate_maildir_list
methods.description: Populates a list with filenames from Maildir subdirectories.

methods.name: maildir_filename_cmp
methods.description: Comparator for sorting mail filenames numerically.

methods.name: split_maildir
methods.description: Splits emails from a Maildir into individual files.

methods.name: split_mbox
methods.description: Splits emails from an mbox file into individual files.

methods.name: cmd_mailsplit
methods.description: Main command function to split mail files or directories into individual message files.
